items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Kurt Bloom was playing the other tenor... I wasn't too happy with that. That band got out of my control.

ctx.x: Kurt Bloom, Mike Goldberg, tenor sax, Danny Bank, baritone sax, Ralph Burns, piano, Turk Van Lake, guitar, Chubby Jackson. Chubby Jackson and Oscar Pettiford, bass?
Yes. I had -- that's an interesting story, when we get around to it. I had both of them.
